name: Hennepin Healthcare hospital volunteers (ages 16 and up)
what_you_do: Volunteer at a Level 1 trauma hospital in downtown Minneapolis. Most new volunteers start in Welcome Services, helping patients and guests find their way, then can move to other departments.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 and up. You should be reliable, helpful and respectful of all people.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Free ramp parking while you volunteer.
duration: Start with a 4-hour shift once a week for 8 weeks. The yearly minimum is 40 to 80 hours, depending on whether you are a high school student, college student or adult.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Apply any time and finish the steps within 6 weeks.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online volunteer application. Then interview with Volunteer Services, give shot records and TB test results, do a background check with fingerprints, and finish an online orientation.
notes: You can ask for a reference after you finish your service. Volunteer Services: 612-873-2512, volunteerservices@hcmed.org, 900 South 8th Street, Minneapolis.
